map_role: Dual stranded-vessel salvage drydock with a below-keel racing bypass and entered service holds
density_profile: Separated high cutter and low salvage hull, widely open interstice, dense west customs and east catcher, intentionally underfurnished basal vaults

route_grammar.eastbound: West breaker launch, descending bow chute, lower run below both hanging vessels, east reversal
route_grammar.westbound: Elevated and entered salvage holds from east to west, with local hatch descents and a lower-keel recovery choice
route_grammar.fallback: When the upper cutter aft gallery is blocked, the beneath-keel lane returns west to finish without using the gallery

strong_motifs: Two full-width-scale side-elevation cutter hull profiles at intentionally different elevations
Roof-rooted paired salvager winches and diagonal load ties
Abandoned open cargo bays and wide entered keel hatches
Plain heavy shipbreaker customs tiers at west and inverted V catcher at east
interesting_relationships: Lower second vessel is downstream of higher first vessel but remains accessible through a separate upper hatch and lower return lane
Independent roof hoist and bedrock footing networks support functional cutter rooms without floor-to-roof blockades
Forward/mid/aft salvage rooms offer optional flights while the under-keel corridor avoids deliberate obstructions
Three successive unused subterranean vaults remain directly entered from the main flight space

authoring_affordances.value: Human-editable salvage workers' shelter and NPC settlement pocket
Unscripted payload transfer, crane activation or cargo interception stage
Editable collapse and alternate exit, with viable lower bypass
Maintenance/ambush chamber with distinct escape down to the under-keel course
Unfurnished underground expansion seam, intentionally preserved

procedural_exemplar_value: Teaches example-derived grammars of paired, differently elevated segmented vehicle hulls, roof-supported load transfer, optional entered machinery interiors, berth-like lower bypasses, salvage setpieces and intentional incomplete chambers; distinguishes passable hulls from side-on scenery.
similarity_avoidance: Avoids the preceding annulus/ring, ratchet/sawtooth five-tray, suspended diaphragm and broken crater-bridge layouts. This map's organizing grammar is two separately supported stranded vessel silhouettes with aligned optional entered holds and a shared keel return, not a renamed corridor stack.
